items.title: California fines Afterpay $2.7M
items.why: BNPL ability-to-repay scrutiny is rising; build underwriting and affordability checks into diligence on any embedded BNPL partner.
items.summary_ai: California fined Afterpay $2.7M for failing to assess customers' ability to repay its BNPL loans.
items.take: BNPL ability-to-repay scrutiny is rising; build underwriting and affordability checks into diligence on any embedded BNPL partner.

items.title: Buy-Now-Pay-Later Catches On With Wealthy Households Earning Over ¥16 Million, Block Survey Finds
items.why: Pay-over-time adoption among high earners in China suggests installment features may resonate with affluent cardholders too.
items.summary_ai: A Block survey finds buy-now-pay-later use is growing among wealthy Chinese households earning above the threshold.
items.take: Pay-over-time adoption among high earners in China suggests installment features may resonate with affluent cardholders too.

items.title: Even affluent shoppers are embracing buy now, pay later, Block data shows
items.why: Affluent BNPL use argues for installment features on premium cards, not treating BNPL as a low-income product.
items.summary_ai: Block data shows affluent shoppers are increasingly using buy now, pay later, not only lower-income buyers.
items.take: Affluent BNPL use argues for installment features on premium cards, not treating BNPL as a low-income product.
